paragraphs: I’m Abdulrahman Nahhas, a university student from Homs, Syria. I like understanding how things work, then trying to build something with what I’ve learned.

I started with web applications and found my way toward embedded systems. These days, Rust has a lot of my attention. I’ve also been learning Nix and getting more comfortable with the systems underneath the software.
Some of my earlier work was with community and human rights organizations. It taught me to start with the people who need a tool, and to care about making it clear and useful.
This site is my place to keep the different threads together: what I build, what I use, and what I’m still working out.

principles.title: Understand the moving parts.
principles.description: I like tools that let me look underneath, ask questions, and keep learning.

principles.title: Start with someone’s real problem.
principles.description: The work I’ve done with communities keeps bringing me back to the person using the thing.

principles.title: Leave room to be a beginner.
principles.description: A small experiment and a better question are both worthwhile outcomes.
